text:
Healthy reconstruction margins do not establish strong next-item ranking: interior masks can use right context unavailable at the terminal mask. [BERT4Rec](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06690) uses masked-item training and appended-mask inference; [recency-sampling research](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/273792/2/273792.pdf) explicitly questions how closely general reconstruction matches next-item prediction. Practical hypothesis: increase terminal-only masked training on training-history prefixes, keeping the target absent from bidirectional input. Treat improvement on Electronics as unproven; compare using the fixed macro validation HR@10.

Online mining can remain within one BERT4Rec: score a random candidate pool with its terminal-mask representation, then select negatives without a separately fitted scorer. However, highest-scoring unobserved items may be false negatives. [Hard-BPR (2024)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19276) develops an objective robust to this problem; its evidence is from implicit collaborative filtering, so transfer to BERT4Rec requires testing. A conservative experimental design would mix uniform and moderately hard negatives, exclude known training positives, and soften extreme-negative penalties. These are hypotheses, not established fixes. [A 2024 sequential-recommendation study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17276) also finds sampling effects depend on dataset and popularity band.

Full softmax provides a useful objective control but scores every catalog item per supervised position; candidate-pool mining reduces output scoring while adding selection overhead. Hard-selected sampled cross-entropy is not automatically an unbiased full-softmax approximation. [Correcting the LogQ Correction (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09331) identifies residual sampling bias from treating the always-present positive as sampled. Compare terminal-mask full softmax against same-model mixed-negative training under equal GPU budgets, recording validation HR@10 and throughput; reconstruction margins alone cannot identify the cause of weak ranking.
